evidence_chain.link: The patient's symptoms and the presence of a small bowel obstruction pattern support the diagnosis of Gastrointestinal Obstruction (B1).
The absence of diarrhea and the presence of obstipation (F19) make Gastrointestinal Motility Disorder (B2) less likely.

ranked_facts.why: The patient's symptoms of nausea, vomiting, and abdominal distension, along with the presence of a small bowel obstruction pattern, support the diagnosis of Gastrointestinal Obstruction (B1). In contrast, the absence of diarrhea and the presence of obstipation (F19) make Gastrointestinal Motility Disorder (B2) less likely.
